title: Contracts (town delivery proposals the player accepts, bonus on completion, no failure penalty)

maxContracts.description: Contracts the list holds at most, whatever their status. 0 disables contracts.

maxAccepted.description: Contracts that can be accepted at once (not above maxContracts).

initialProposals.description: Proposals a new game starts with (capped by maxContracts); afterwards one proposal appears per month while the list is below maxContracts.

minAmount.description: Inclusive minimum units a contract asks for.

maxAmount.description: Inclusive maximum units a contract asks for (not below minAmount).

durationMonths.description: Calendar months an accepted contract has to be delivered, counted from the day it is accepted.

rewardMultiplier.description: Completion bonus = amount x cargo price per unit x this multiplier, rounded down.

townPopulationBonus.description: Inhabitants added to a town when the reward of a contract targeting it is claimed (capped at the town maximum).
